pois.name: Summit
pois.note: Real GMRT terrain (Ryan et al. 2009; value read directly from this tile's grid): this tile's single shallowest cell, -975.17 m (matches data/tiles/kamaehuakanaloa/meta.json max_m), matching published summit-depth figures (~1,000 m / 3,200 ft) closely. This is the current high point on the post-1996-collapse summit, not necessarily the exact pre-1996 'Pele's Vents' high point (see kh-hiolo-north/south).

pois.name: Hiolo North vent site
pois.note: Real GMRT terrain: -1,300.3 m at this point, ~660 m southwest of the summit POI, matching the published depth of the Hiolo North vent site (~1,300 m, within Pele's Pit) closely. This tile's ~58x61 m grid does not resolve Pele's Pit's own reported ~600 m-diameter crater rim, so this point is this survey's closest real-terrain approach to Hiolo North's published depth, not a traced crater outline. `reconstruction: true`: the low-temperature chimney/mat props placed here approximate the site's appearance, not a surveyed structure.

pois.name: Hiolo South vent site
pois.note: Real GMRT terrain: -1,274.3 m at this point, ~330 m from Hiolo North, matching the published depth of Hiolo South (~1,274 m) closely. Same grid-resolution caveat as Hiolo North. `reconstruction: true` for the same reason.

pois.name: South rift zone
pois.note: Real GMRT terrain, -1,281.3 m, about 1.4 km south of the summit on the ridge this session traced running south from the summit -- the general direction of the seamount's south rift zone, published as its longest (~12 mile) and most volcanically/hydrothermally active rift. This point is a terrain trace along that bearing, not a citation to a mapped rift-zone boundary.

pois.name: Lower south flank
pois.note: Real GMRT terrain, -1,896.6 m, about 3.4 km south of the summit along the same south-rift transect. Included to show the seamount's real scale (published as rising over 3,000 m / 10,000 ft above the surrounding seafloor); this tile does not reach its base. Optional, distant objective.
